# ***AGI Supplies List***

**Elementary K3-8th![](http://www.americangroup-international.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/a666b371-360b-4788-9961-07c1f26ddec6-1.jpg)**

Change of clothes!
Tissues or toilet paper
2- 5 subject notebooks
3- packs of pencils
2- packs of erasers
2- pencil sharpeners
2- packs of white paper
1- pack of colored paper
1- pack of colored markers or pencils
1- whiteboard markers
1 - pack highlighters
1- scissors
2- glue sticks
2- paint and paint brushes
2- wet wipes

**High School Supplies Grade 9-12th![](http://www.americangroup-international.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/30849091_10213959820221357_304857339_o-1024x768.jpg)**

2- packs of white paper
3- white-out
3- packs pencils
2- glue sticks
